items.information: Information DK Der vil være skilte på hoveddøren, og dørene åbner kl. 9:30. Transport: Der er parkeringspladser ved venuen. Det er nemt at komme til venuen ved offentlig transport da der er mange togforbindelser til Slagelse St. Nærmere informationer kan findes på rejseplanen.dk, hvor destinationen kan sættes til stoppestedet 'Selandia'. Der er ca. 20 minutters gang fra Slagelse St. Mad: Der ligger en McDonald's og Burger King 2 km fra gymnasiet, og en Lidl 600 m fra gymnasiet. Overnatning: Det er ikke muligt at overnatte på venue. Information EN Follow the signs at the main entrance. The venue will open at 9 AM. Transport: There are parking spots at the venue. It is easy to commute to the venue by public transport, as many trains stop in Slagelse. You can take a train directly from the train station at Copenhagen Airport to Slagelse St., or a train from Copenhagen Airport to Copenhagen Central Station, and then a train to Slagelse St. Further information can be found on rejseplanen.dk, where the destination can be set to the bus stop 'Selandia' or Slagelse St. The walk from Slagelse St. to the venue is around 20 minutes. Food: There is a McDonald's and Burger King 2 km from the venue, and a grocery store 600 m from the venue. Accommodation: It is not possible to sleep at the venue, but there are following options: Danhostel Slagelse (1,5 km) (http://danhostel-slagelse.dk/) Hotel Frederik d.II (2,1 km) (http://www.fr2.dk/) Hotel Antvorskov (3,2 km) (http://www.hotelantvorskov.dk/en/)

items.information: Hamilton Winter 2016 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the Rubik's Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. There are a variety of events from the regular 3x3 Rubik's Cube, to big 7x7 cubes, one-handed solving, and even blindfolded solving! The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, you may want to look at CubingUSA's Competitor Tutorial.
